title_en: Character Riddles (4/20): Mother and Child Together
note_en: 好 has two readings. As hǎo it means "good" (好吃 "tasty," 你好 "hello"); as hào, in 爱好 "hobby" and 好奇 "curious," it means "to like, be fond of." English has the same trick with words like "record" (noun) vs. "record" (verb): the spelling stays, the pronunciation and meaning shift, so watch which reading a word takes.
